title: Online Job Applications Invited – Apply Now!
text:
📢 Job Applications Invited

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is inviting applications for faculty positions. Please find details in the advertisements below:

Associate Professors & Professor – Advertisement No. 64 (https://news.awkum.edu.pk/2025/12/applications-invited-for-posts-of.html)

Assistant Professors & Lecturers – Advertisement No. 65 (https://news.awkum.edu.pk/2025/12/applications-invited-for-posts-of_2.html)
